Primary request: Create one original Palari, identity "slender capsule pod with a suspended teal oval and close-set arms." Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- silhouette: grounded pod with one continuous rounded ceramic body, an adult collectible proportion, body height at least 2.4 times visible face height, specifically a slender vertical capsule
- crown: continuous integrated ceramic dome
- opening: one deliberate suspended vertical oval aperture, entirely below the face, with a continuous ceramic bridge between face and aperture
- pose: both close-set rounded arms resting close to the body
- expression: serene
- exterior material: warm creamy ivory ceramic
- characteristic color: deep ceramic teal #146B68
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, deep ceramic teal, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional opening and no other supporting reveal
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, teal iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy

- exactly six circular seed-mark apertures as one compact lower-body rectangle: four larger circular apertures at its four corners plus two smaller apertures centered vertically between them; not a grille and no extra dots
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- visibly honor the slender pod, integrated dome, suspended oval, close-set resting arms, and serene expression
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, full figure visible and centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.
